title: sdr-daily-scratchpad-mia-harper-2026-03-10
content:
TODAY (Tue 2026-03-10) - Mia Harper - SDR daily scratchpad

Top priorities:
- 9:30-10:00 AM: Cadence calls (follow-ups) — priority accounts flagged by AMs.
- 11:00 AM: Discovery with inbound lead (ACME Health) if patched in. Prep notes below.
- Demo request handoffs: push 3 warm MQLs to AE queue before EOD.

Call list (ordered):
1) ACME Health (SFDC OPP-0045123) - call at 11:00 AM. Owner: AE - Jordan Lee. Notes: inbound form - interested in private deployment/VPC, compliance questions. Prep: confirm data residency needs, ask about typical concurrent requests and latency SLOs. Send docs link after call: Confluence:/private-deployments/overview.
2) Harborside Logistics - 10:00 AM follow-up (left voicemail 3/6). Prospect: CTO - Rahul Mehta. Goal: schedule intro + cost discussion (Dedicated). Key msg: reserved capacity reduces per-token variance; mention 99.9% uptime SLA.
3) Nimbus Analytics - cold call 2nd attempt - mention Redwood Optimize and cost savings for heavy batch embedding jobs. 
4) Brightwell FinServ (AE-owned) - quick check on rollout timeline, can offer canary deploy for new model.

Quick call notes / snippets:
- ACME Health: "Compliance + data residency are the blockers today" -> bring up Private deployment options, KMS integration, audit logs. Ask for current vendor and monthly token volume estimate.
- Harborside: interested in predictable throughput for nightly batch jobs. Mention Dedicated autoscaling and burst options. Ask for GPU hours estimate.
- Nimbus: embed-heavy workload; propose embedding batching + caching to cut costs. Ask about embedding frequency (real-time vs batch).

Templates to send (quick copy/paste):
- Post-call ACME email: "Thanks Rahul — quick follow-up with the Private deployment brief and our KMS integrations doc. As discussed, next steps: 1) share compliance checklist, 2) schedule technical deep-dive with infra, 3) provide monthly token/sample workload. Can you share an estimate for concurrent requests and data residency requirements?"
- Harborside follow-up: "Left a quick voicemail — Rahul, want to sync on Dedicated capacity options and expected GPU hours. If you have a rough weekly batch window, I can loop Jordan (AE) to scope cost."

To-do / action items (checked = done):
- [ ] Log ACME call notes into SFDC + attach inbound form (after 11:00).
- [ ] Create meeting invite with Jordan & infra AE for technical deep-dive (target next Tue).
- [ ] Update playbook snippet for "Private deployment FAQs" with the KMS/HSM section. (Reference Confluence link above)
- [x] Send pricing snapshot to prospect list #B (sent 3/9)
- [ ] Add Harborside GPU estimate question to discovery checklist template.

Pipeline quick view (high level):
- ACME Health - inbound (high intent) -> needs compliance certs, Private demo -> Stage: Discovery
- Harborside Logistics - outbound (warm) -> Stage: Qualification
- Nimbus Analytics - outbound (cold) -> Stage: Outreach
- Brightwell FinServ - AE nurture -> Stage: AE Owned

Notes & friction points to flag to AMs/AE:
- Compliance docs sometimes outdated; send updated KMS + audit-log attachments.
- Pricing pushback expected for embedding-heavy use cases; highlight Optimize recommendations and batching savings to reduce unit cost.

Links & refs to attach after calls:
- Confluence:/private-deployments/overview
- Confluence:/security/kms-integration-guide
- Redwood hosted API quickstart (public link)
- SFDC OPP-0045123 // attach form responses

Random thoughts / drafts (brain dump):
- Idea: small "compliance one-pager" tailored to healthcare that lists controls + timelines to reduce back-and-forth. Could be a templated PDF we attach to inbound leads.
- Consider running a short email A/B for Dedicated messaging: "predictable throughput" vs "SLA-backed latency" — measure reply rate. Loop growth for A/B test.

End-of-day goals:
- 3 meaningful follow-ups logged in SFDC
- 1 technical deep-dive scheduled
- Move 1 MQL to AE demo stage

Slack reminders to self:
- ping @jordan about available slots for ACME deep-dive
- drop note in #sdr-desk about A/B test idea

That's it for today — quick checkpoint at 3:30 PM to triage any urgent replies.
